name: Coconut Chicken Salad with Honey Mustard Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken into 1-½ inch strips; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine the shredded coconut, breadcrumbs, and garlic powder.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups shredded unsweetened coconut
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: In another small bowl, whisk the eggs with the water.

Dip the chicken tenders into the egg and then into the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 30 minutes, turning once, halfway through. (Use two baking sheets if necessary.)
In a small bowl, whisk together the Dijon, oil, honey, and vinegar; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce (Skip spring mix if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
6 medium carrots
3 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice the cucumbers. Halve the grape tomatoes.
Trim and peel the carrots, then julienne or coarsely grate them.
To serve, divide the spring mix, cucumbers, tomatoes, and carrots between bowls. Top with baked chicken strips and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
